 What Kambi Group Holders Bought Into
 Al Bentley Sun, November 15, 2026 at 6:08 AM EST 4 min read KAMBI.ST +1.31% 
 If Kambi Group sat on your watchlist rather than in your portfolio, the recent move may feel like a missed shot after the whistle. For Kambi Group shareholders, the return from the start of the year was 29.6%, including dividends. That outcome invites a simple question. Back on 1 January 2026, with bulls focused on global legalization and bears worried about regulation and client churn, what business assumptions about regulated market expansion could have helped you spot this setup earlier? 
 A Narrative on Simply Wall St is one investor's written case for a company, with its growth, margin and multiple assumptions spelled out. Those assumptions imply an estimated Fair Value. 
 The easy part of this move is behind Kambi Group. Zero in on 196 high quality undervalued stocks for companies trading below our estimates. 
 The Two Stories Investors Had To Choose Between On Kambi Group 
 The shares cost SEK137 at the start of the period, so any view on Kambi Group hinged on whether that price already reflected its regulated betting opportunity. 
 The bullish Narrative pointed to a Fair Value of SEK155 and assumed that gradual legalization of sports betting, especially in Latin America with deals like RedCap and Brazil, would support multi year revenue growth as markets opened. 
 The bearish Narrative put Fair Value at SEK115 and focused on the risk that tighter regulation and higher gaming taxes could compress margins and limit transaction based revenue growth over time. 
 OM:KAMBI Trailing 12-Month Earnings & Revenue History as at Nov 2026 What The Evidence Did To The Kambi Group Argument 
 The QuinnBet agreement gave Kambi Group fresh proof for the bullish case that new regulated partnerships can add to its sportsbook network. Reported Q3 2026 revenue of €45.98m and net income of €3.37m, with net margin at 7.3% against 2.7% a year earlier, supported the profitability side of that argument. The evidence still cut both ways. 
 The lesson is simple. When a thesis depends on regulated expansion and margin resilience, track new contract wins alongside net margin in each quarterly filing to determine whether extra volume is arriving on better, worse, or similar economics. 
 What Kambi Group's Run Up To SEK170 Now Asks You To Believe 
 Kambi Group shares now trade at SEK170, up from SEK137 from the start of the year, and the analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St places its Fair Value above that level based on its own assumptions rather than as a stated fact. 
 That Narrative leans on AI driven trading and higher margin products as key swing factors, and argues the current price still does not fully credit the possibility that these newer products scale fast enough to outweigh regulatory taxes and client migrations. 
 Story Continues "Key Takeaways: Analysts expect Kambi Group to keep building on AI-driven trading, higher-margin products and a broader partner base. This supports the view that the business is undervalued and positioned for further earnings growth to be recognised over time. The main requirement is that Kambi Group continues to scale its AI trading system and higher-margin Bet Builder and esports products, while offsetting client migrations and rising gaming taxes, so that recent improvements in adjusted EBITA and operator trading margins remain sustainable." 
 That disagreement has a full argument behind it. → Uncover the higher Fair Value this Narrative argues for 
 Another Way Regulated Leisure Grows 
 Kambi Group lives on regulated betting demand. Your next question is where else regulated leisure spending might quietly build. 
 One obvious neighbor is holiday travel, where guests trade cash for experiences instead of wagers. Here, a different operator assembles full trips on the water. 
 This business leans on private destinations, curated routes and loyalty programs. It aims to draw travelers from land holidays, then deepen spending once onboard. 
 Fuel efficiency work and refreshed vessels matter too, because they shape trip economics even when cabins are already booked. 
 If Kambi Group made you study regulation and consumer appetite, this adjacent operator invites the same lens on leisure, debt and cash conversion. 
 One Narrative has already put a figure on it. → Uncover the company trading 14% below one Narrative's Fair Value
